errors: No mathematical content, so there are no mathematical errors. The machine transcription treats the bleed-through as a separate document dated 1864. In fact the ghosted date and title reproduce the recto's '24 Juli 1861' and '1860'.

results.what: Bookseller's interim invoice (Deuerlich, Göttingen) to Prof. Riemann for 'Accessionen der Universitätsbibliothek 1860', 15 groschen, dated 24 July 1861. It is visible here only as mirror-image bleed-through.

deep.surprise_reason: The page has no mathematics. It is only the reversed show-through of a book invoice on the recto.
transcription_corrections: The entire page is mirror-image bleed-through of folio 31r, not an independent document.
The date '[illegible] 1864' should read '24 Juli 1861', as on the recto.
The item line '... 1864 [?] 15' is the reversed '1. Accessionen der Universitätsbibliothek. 1860. | . | 15'.
'auf Bestellung: zu beigesetzten Preisen' should read 'auf Bestellung; zur geneigten Ansicht', with these options struck through as on the recto.
The addressee line is 'Herr Professor Riemann Hochwohlgeboren' (reversed).
